data.summary:
Senior Business Analyst | Test Manager | Core Banking | Payments | SWIFT | ISO 20022 | AI- Assisted Business Analysis | UAT | SQL Validation - BFSI
Senior Business Analyst with 17 years of Banking and Financial Services experience comprising 5 years in Retail Banking Operations, 7 years in Core Banking Business Analysis, and 4.7 years in Payments Transformation. Expertise in requirements analysis, FSD preparation, stakeholder management, cross Border payment, regression testing, UAT, SQL validation, and deployment support. Currently supporting the Central Bank of Kuwait through TCS, playing a key role in SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 migration and payment message implementations including pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.009 COV, pacs.004, and pacs.002.
17 years of Banking and Financial Services (BFS) experience, comprising 5 years in Retail Banking Operations, 7 years in Core Banking Business Analysis at CSB Bank, and 4.7+ years in IT Consulting with TCS.
Strong experience working with the Central Bank of Kuwait and regulatory banking clients, acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams.
Specialized in Payments Systems, SWIFT MT-to-MX Migration (ISO 20022), Core Banking Platforms, and Regulatory Payment Transformation Initiatives.
Leveraged Microsoft Copilot for FSD preparation, requirements analysis, user story creation, and test case generation, improving delivery efficiency and documentation quality.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and test scenarios, ensuring regulatory compliance and operational accuracy.
Skilled in SQL-based data validation, reconciliation, and reporting to ensure transaction accuracy and data integrity. Hands-on experience in REST API analysis and testing using Postman, validating request/response payloads, API workflows, and backend integrations. Experienced in initiating posting requests through SoapUI, with working knowledge of WinSCP and PuTTY for file transfers, batch execution, and production support activities.
Extensive hands-on experience in Manual, Functional, SIT, UAT, and Regression Testing, including test planning, execution, defect management, and business sign-off activities.
• Deep functional expertise in Retail Banking, Core Banking Operations, Payments
Processing, and Backend Accounting Validation, ensuring accurate data integrity checks and stable production releases.
